SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
Harbour Digestive Centre (fictional)
Gastroscopy and Colonoscopy Procedure Note
Date of service: 2026-10-29
Endoscopist: Synthetic Endoscopist, MD (fictional)
Sedation: propofol by a CRNA (fictional)
The gastroscope was advanced to the second part of the duodenum. Cold forceps biopsies were obtained from the gastric
antrum. The colonoscope was then advanced to the cecum. A 7 mm polyp in the transverse colon was removed with a cold snare.
Biopsies were not obtained.
